subject: Regional fleet allocation & APAC dedicated pool request (Neurolytics)
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@neurolytics.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@neurolytics.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: APAC dedicated pool + latency SLO for D-98732

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We scoped internal commitments for the Neurolytics pilot and have a firm ask: to reliably support their inference workload in APAC (Singapore) we need a dedicated pool with local KV cache and burst capacity. Key asks below — can you confirm feasibility and a rough sizing/lead time?

- Target sustained concurrency: 120 QPS (avg token length ~90) during peak windows (08:00–20:00 SGT).
- 99th percentile token latency target: <= 120ms for streaming chat responses.
- Required regional data residency and KMS integration.
- Committed monthly TU (token-units) equivalent: ~1.3B tokens/month for the first 6 months.
- Soft start date: Nov 1, 2026 (pilot), then scale to GA by Jan 2027 if SLA met.

I attached a brief MOP and an initial SLA draft. We know this is tight with H100 supply — please advise tradeoffs (A100 vs H100, quantization options, burst vs reserved) and a recommended pool SKU that balances latency and unit cost.

Appreciate the quick guidance — Priya

Attachments: Neurolytics_MOP_v2.pdf, SLA-Commitment-Draft.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@neurolytics.ai>

Priya — thanks, clear ask. Looping in Karthik/Marissa for deal constraints and Jonas for infra sizing. High-level thoughts now; I'll follow up with a sizing proposal and options doc by EOD Monday.

Immediate notes:
- Residency/KMS: supported in Private and Dedicated; will need a KMS key grant and CNF for Singapore region. Ops lead will coordinate with your security team.
- Latency: 120ms p99 for streaming is achievable with H100-backed pool and tuned batching; A100 may hit 120–160ms depending on model variant and prefix cache hit rate.
- Token budget: 1.3B/mo is medium commit — we can map to dedicated tranches to keep unit economics reasonable.

Karthik/Marissa — please add any commercial constraints (commit term, burst allowances). Jonas — can you start a quick SKU sketch (A100 vs H100 counts, memory for KV caching, approximate GPU-hours/day) so we can present tradeoffs to Neurolytics?

— Marcus

Subject: RE: Request: APAC dedicated pool + latency SLO for D-98732

Team — attaching an initial APAC SKU worksheet (apac-pool-skus.xlsx) and a short sizing note. Summary: three options that trade latency vs cost.

Option A (Latency-first, prep for GA):
- 8x H100 (80GB) dedicated GPUs with local NVMe for KV caching; burst pool of additional 2x H100 for peak surges.
- Expected p99 streaming token latency: ~90–110ms with continuous KV cache hit-rate >65%.
- Approx GPU-hours/day: 192.
- Lead time: 6–8 weeks (H100 procurement/backfill dependent).

Option B (Balanced):
- 12x A100 (80GB) with aggressive quantization + model distillation recommended; add prefix cache layer and larger batch tuning.
- Expected p99: ~130–160ms (depends on quantization level).
- Approx GPU-hours/day: 288.
- Lead time: 3–4 weeks (A100 supply easier).

Option C (Cost-first):
- 16x A100 (40GB) with token-level caching and higher reliance on batching; accept p99 ~160–220ms.
- Lower unit cost but risk to SLA.

Notes/assumptions:
- Measurements assume model variant rwd-llm-13b-optimized; larger models will materially increase latency.
- If Neurolytics needs strict 100ms p99, we should push Option A and negotiate lead time/backfill as a commercial condition.
- KV cache sizing: allocate ~20TB NVMe to hit 65%+ prefix cache for their traffic mix.

Next steps:
1) Karthik/Marissa to propose term & burst allowances for each option.
2) Marcus to confirm KMS/region onboarding tasks and expected timelines.
3) We (platform) will validate deployment runbook with GlobalCloud Ops (ops@globalcloud.com) in parallel.

— Jonas

Attachments: apac-pool-skus.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

All — I ran the commercial numbers with Marissa. Quick proposal to align sales + infra constraints:

- Pilot (Nov 1 start): Option B (Balanced) on a 3-month pilot term, committed to 1.3B tokens/mo. Allow one 48-hour burst (2x additional A100s) per month at no extra charge during pilot to prove latency. Pricing: pilot blended committed rate with a capped overage rate.
- GA (Jan 1 target): If pilot SLAs met, move to Option A commitment for 12 months with a firm H100-backed pool and a 10% burst buffer. We will include a lead-time clause and make H100 provisioning a contingent item in the contract.

Commercial ask to infra: can we guarantee the burst window and the migration path from A100 -> H100 without downtime? If not, we need an explicit failover policy.

Marissa — please prepare redlines on the SLA-Commitment-Draft.docx to reflect pilot allowances and the lead-time contingency.

— Karthik
